body: {"choices": [{"finish_reason": "tool_calls", "index": 0, "message": {"content": "The integer-encoded path also works correctly with the fix.\n\nLet me also run a broader fuzzing comparison to be extra safe, comparing Redis GETRANGE against a reference implementation for many random combinations including negative values:", "role": "assistant", "tool_calls": [{"function": {"arguments": "{\"command\":\"cd /testbed && cat > /tmp/fuzz.tcl <<'EOF'\\n# Reference implementation matching Redis semantics (with the fix)\\nproc ref_range {str start end} {\\n    set strlen [string length $str]\\n    if {$start < 0 && $end < 0 && $start > $end} { return \\\"\\\" }\\n    if {$start < 0} { set start [expr {$strlen + $start}] }\\n    if {$end < 0} { set end [expr {$strlen + $end}] }\\n    if {$start < 0} { set start 0 }\\n    if {$end < 0} { return \\\"\\\" }\\n    if {$end >= $strlen} { set end [expr {$strlen - 1}] }\\n    if {$start > $end || $strlen == 0} { return \\\"\\\" }\\n    return [string range $str $start $end]\\n}\\n\\nset PORT 16793\\nset r [redis $PORT 0 1]\\n$r set fuzzkey \\\"Hello World, this is a test string!!\\\"\\n\\nset fails 0\\nfor {set i 0} {$i < 5000} {incr i} {\\n    set s [expr {int(rand()*20) - 10}]\\n    set e [expr {int(rand()*20) - 10}]\\n    set expected [ref_range [$r get fuzzkey] $s $e]\\n    set actual [$r getrange fuzzkey $s $e]\\n    if {$expected ne $actual} {\\n        incr fails\\n        puts \\\"MISMATCH s=$s e=$e expected='$expected' actual='$actual'\\\"\\n    }\\n}\\nputs \\\"fuzz fails=$fails\\\"\\n$r shutdown nosave\\nEOF\\n# Need redis tcl lib\\ngrep -rn \\\"proc redis \\\" /testbed/tests/support/*.tcl | head\"}", "name": "bash"}, "id": "call_-7355413519132522390", "index": 0, "type": "function"}]}}], "created": 1700000036, "id": "synthesized-00036", "model": "glm-5.2", "object": "chat.completion", "request_id": "synthesized-00036", "usage": {"completion_tokens": 0, "prompt_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 0}}
